in_hebrew.name: Kresimirka
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Graceful, merciful one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kresimirka הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Kresimirov, composed of Krse, meaning grace, and mir, meaning mercy. In Croatian folklore, Saint Kresimir is known for his grace and mercy towards the people.

in_greek.name: Kresimirka
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Graceful, merciful one
in_greek.long_meaning: Kresimirka είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Kresimirov, composed of Krse, meaning grace, and mir, meaning mercy. In Croatian folklore, Saint Kresimir is known for his grace and mercy towards the people.

in_latin.name: Kresimirka
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Graceful, merciful one
in_latin.long_meaning: Kresimirka est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Kresimirov, composed of Krse, meaning grace, and mir, meaning mercy. In Croatian folklore, Saint Kresimir is known for his grace and mercy towards the people.
